marco: Quick question - seasonal contractor started Nov 1, accrual pro-rated but we have a year-end policy that limits carryover. Their contract extended through March. Can we allow prorated carryover of unused PTO into the next fiscal year for contractors?

sylvie: Contractors usually don't carry PTO unless contractor agreement specifies it. If this is an employee on a fixed-term offer, we follow the pro-rata accrual and carryover cap. Need to check offer letter.

ben: If we treat them as employees, the cap remains 40h; for contractors, if the vendor contract says unused time is paid out, that's a payroll payment code. Please send the contract.

marco: Contract says "accrued time paid at termination" but no carryover language. Manager hoping to avoid payout and instead move hours to next fiscal year.

payroll: payroll: Note - paying out accrued PTO at termination triggers different tax treatment + 3rd party vendor fees in some states. We can't unilaterally carryover for a contractor unless vendor amends contract.

sylvie: Recommendation: vendor amendment or manager covers the hours as unpaid. I'll start vendor outreach template.

people-ops-bot: people-ops-bot: Template for vendor amendment: /docs/hr/vendor-amendment-template.md

marco: OK I'll loop in vendor. Thanks!
